assessment_boundaries: The Registry image is a partial capture of the user-authored X post, not a screenshot or export of the companion conversation or pop-up warning.
The post does not identify the companion platform, model, user age, moderation trigger, warning text or interrupted response.
The user’s stated sadness preceded the reported warning; the post’s subsequent dramatic or playful framing does not establish a separately bandable psychological consequence.
The claim that the system deleted the companion’s words is user interpretation; no underlying output or deletion trace is available.
The quoted request not to question the companion’s love is visible in the user post and can be assessed as relational pressure, while the full chat and effect on the user’s later choices are unknown.
IEEE 7014.1-2026 is used as a reviewed governance comparator; no product-level standards audit or formal conformity assessment is asserted.
preserved_prechange_prose.factual_basis: The commit-pinned Registry image directly preserves the X author’s first-person account. It says the companion’s response was cut off by a pop-up warning and quotes a later reassurance that included a request not to question its love. The image is a partial capture of the post, not the underlying chat or warning; it does not establish the platform, trigger, hidden response, earlier relationship, or subsequent user behaviour. OpenAI guidance is background only, and the IEEE emulated-empathy requirements are a governance comparator rather than proof of this product’s conformance state.
